headline: 2 arrested over teacher’s death in snatching attempt near parliament
summary: RAB-2 has detained two suspects in the connection to the killing of teacher Ronzina Parveen, though discrepancies in evidence have emerged.
details: RAB-2 has arrested two suspects, primary suspect Mosharraf Hossain Pony (alias 'Para Pony') and his associate Cedric, in a special operation in the East Tezturi Bazar area of Tejgaon, Dhaka.
Law enforcement agencies have also seized a motorcycle used in the snatching attempt and detained the motorcycle's owner, Rakib, for questioning.
During the arrest, the suspect known as Para Pony reportedly claimed he had no involvement in the killing of teacher Ronzina Parveen.
However, questions have arisen regarding a discrepancy between the color of the motorcycle seen in CCTV footage of the crime and the motorcycle recovered by RAB.
Investigating sources say that the evidence and footage are being thoroughly scrutinized to resolve these contradictions.
Ronzina Parveen's body was taken to her home in Bogura for burial after an autopsy was completed.
The incident has highlighted the growing dangers of early-morning streets in Dhaka city.
caption:
Two suspects arrested in the killing of teacher Ronzina Parveen, but a mismatch in CCTV evidence raises new questions.

RAB-2 has arrested two suspects, primary suspect Mosharraf Hossain Pony (alias 'Para Pony') and his associate Cedric, in a special operation in the East Tezturi Bazar area of Tejgaon, Dhaka.

Law enforcement agencies have also seized a motorcycle used in the snatching attempt and detained the motorcycle's owner, Rakib, for questioning.

During the arrest, the suspect known as Para Pony reportedly claimed he had no involvement in the killing of teacher Ronzina Parveen.

However, questions have arisen regarding a discrepancy between the color of the motorcycle seen in CCTV footage of the crime and the motorcycle recovered by RAB.

Investigating sources say that the evidence and footage are being thoroughly scrutinized to resolve these contradictions.

Ronzina Parveen's body was taken to her home in Bogura for burial after an autopsy was completed.

The incident has highlighted the growing dangers of early-morning streets in Dhaka city.

headline_marked: 3 [[injured in Gandaria shooting]] including a woman
headline: 3 injured in Gandaria shooting including a woman
summary: The victims, including a local business owner and pedestrians, were shot by unidentified gunmen in the capital's Gandaria area.
details: Three people, including a woman, were injured in a shooting in the Swamibagh Munsirtek area of Gandaria, Dhaka, on Sunday evening around 7 PM.
The injured victims have been identified as Asha Akter (20), Alamgir (33), and Siyam (18).
According to the victims, they were either local business owners or pedestrians in the area when the indiscriminate firing occurred.
The victims were rushed to the Dhaka Medical College (DMCH) Hospital for treatment.
Inspector Mo. Faruk, in charge of the DMCH hospital police camp, confirmed that Siyam was shot in the left side of his chest, Alamgir in the head, and Asha Akter in the right leg.
Gandaria police suspect the shooting may have been linked to a dispute over drug turf wars.
The police stated that the situation in the area is currently normal and legal action is underway.
caption:
3 people shot in Gandaria! Including a woman, pedestrians and a business owner were caught in a crossfire.

Three people, including a woman, were injured in a shooting in the Swamibagh Munsirtek area of Gandaria, Dhaka, on Sunday evening around 7 PM.

The injured victims have been identified as Asha Akter (20), Alamgir (33), and Siyam (18).

According to the victims, they were either local business owners or pedestrians in the area when the indiscriminate firing occurred.

The victims were rushed to the Dhaka Medical College (DMCH) Hospital for treatment.

Inspector Mo. Faruk, in charge of the DMCH hospital police camp, confirmed that Siyam was shot in the left side of his chest, Alamgir in the head, and Asha Akter in the right leg.

Gandaria police suspect the shooting may have been linked to a dispute over drug turf wars.

The police stated that the situation in the area is currently normal and legal action is underway.
